notes.g_voteDelay: Milliseconds between a vote passing and its command running. With g_tweakVote bit 6 on, only map votes wait this long and other votes wait 3 seconds.
notes.g_voteTimeout: After a failed vote, the caller's IP cannot call another for this many seconds times the number of votes it has failed. The count drops by one after five timeouts without another failure; 0 turns this off.
notes.g_tweakVote: Vote behaviour: flood protection by IP, waits after a map loads, whether spectators can vote, and whether only players who voted count toward the result.
notes.g_fraglimitVoteCorrection: Adjust the frag limit when a vote switches the gametype to or from duel.
